Are you a talented hacker with a passion for data engineering and building things that actually run in production? Do you enjoy working close to the metal, solving real problems, and seeing your code go live within hours?

Then you might be the next Quant Infrastructure Student joining our team at Alipes!

About Alipes

At Alipes Capital, we have been a market leader in automating financial markets since our inception in 2008, pioneering fully automated natural language processing systems to read and interpret financial news.

To accomplish our goal of being the best at what we do, we are focused on building a world-class ML engineering workflow, ensuring seamless training, deployment and monitoring of our predictive models.

What you’ll do

• You’ll help us build and improve the ML infrastructure powering our fully automated trading systems. Expect hands‑on work with:

• Python tooling for data processing and rapid model experimentation.

• Scalable pipelines for dataset generation, feature engineering and model training.

• Distributed computing technologies (e.g., Ray, Kubernetes).

• Internal utilities that make it easier for researchers to prototype, validate and deploy models.

• Improving latency, reproducibility and monitoring in our deployment workflows.

You’ll work closely with quantitative researchers and ML engineers, contributing directly to production‑grade systems.

About the team

You’ll join an informal, highly technical Quant team where ownership matters and good ideas move fast. We’re a tight-knit group of researchers across 9 nationalities, all with strong backgrounds in math, modeling, and machine learning - and everyone writes code. We collaborate closely with our software developers and traders, working together on models end‑to‑end and engaging deeply in the technical details that make them work.

About you

• You don’t need years of experience, but you do need curiosity, strong fundamentals, and a willingness to build things that work. You are currently studying either a Bachelor's or Master's in Denmark. We’re looking for someone with:

• A scientific and inquisitive mindset.

• Solid understanding of computer science fundamentals (data structures & algorithms).

• Strong Python skills, especially around data preprocessing or pipeline building.

• Interest in distributed systems or ML Ops.

• Experience working with datasets that don’t fit in memory.

• Familiarity with at least one strongly typed language (C#, C/C++, Rust, etc.).

• Currently enrolled in a technical BSc/MSc program (CS, engineering, math, physics, etc.).

Nice to have

• Hands-on experience with ML workflows (dataset generation → training → evaluation).

• Exposure to distributed computing frameworks (Ray, Spark, Dask).

• Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

• Experience with ML libraries like PyTorch, TensorFlow, XGBoost or CatBoost.

• Interest in algorithmic trading concepts.

• Personal projects that show you like to hack on things, automate stuff, or optimize pipelines.

What we can offer you

• Competitive benefits, including health insurance and 25 days of vacation.

• A modern office in Copenhagen (Nordhavn) with a flexible hybrid work model.

• A flat hierarchy with high levels of trust, autonomy, and freedom to make decisions.

• A valued role with unique responsibilities and plenty of room for creativity.

• Fast feedback and recognition of your contributions in a high-growth company.

• Strong team spirit - successes are celebrated with company events and trips.

Practicalities

To apply, please send us your CV, and attach your BSc and/or MSc grade transcripts to your application. If your profile looks like a good match, we will get in touch to coordinate an online technical test as a first step in the interview process.

If you have specific questions about the role, you are welcome to email us at quant_jobs@alipescapital.com. Please do not send in your applications to this email address, as our interview team will not have visibility to review.

jobs.description:
A three-year position as a Postdoctoral researcher is now available at the Copenhagen Health Complexity Center, Department of Public Health, University of Copenhagen. The Postdoc’s employment is expected to start on 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  About the Center

  You will be employed at the Copenhagen Health Complexity Center, which aims to build a strong scientific foundation for understanding and acting on complex public-health challenges. The Center leverages multi-layered nationwide social and health data combined with an interdisciplinary fusion of methods spanning data science, epidemiology, ethnography, econometrics, and systems science. Our research focuses on the complex interplay of health, social, and environmental factors that shape individuals, families, and networks over time. We emphasise interdisciplinary collaboration, offering you an opportunity to actively engage as a collaborative partner in different projects depending on your interests and expertise. Learn more about the Center and our research, vision, and values here.

  About the Department 

  The Department of Public Health provides the scientific foundation for researchers and educators who aim to improve public health, both nationally and globally, and to create greater insight into the links between health, the individual, and society as well as the ethical, equity, and political implications. This is achieved through research, education, and engagement with stakeholders and the general public along with a broad multidisciplinary research agenda that addresses most aspects of public health at a high international level. More information about the Department of Public Health is available here.

  About the position 

  The position will be nested within the Child Health group at the Center, where we advance knowledge through a combination of research activities that leverage the Center’s data infrastructures and methodological expertise, and engagement with policymakers and practitioners. The Center has developed a strategic partnership with a Danish municipality – the Thriving Communities Lab – which offers a platform for connecting the scientific activities at the Center with real-world health promotion efforts. The focus of this partnership is to enhance the conditions for adolescents to thrive through a dynamic learning process that involves professionals across sectors in the municipality, the local government, and researchers, over a period of several years. One question we will explore is whether computational modelling can usefully bring together local knowledge, scientific evidence, the Center’s data resources, and insights emerging from practical interventions, and so strengthen this learning process. Your work as a postdoc will be anchored around this question. Our vision at the Center is to build on this experience to engage with more municipalities over time, addressing a variety of complex health challenges.

  As a Postdoc, your responsibilities will primarily consist of: 

   	
• Spearheading the development of a decision-support/scenario exploration tool that offers policymakers a way to visualize and simulate systemic effects of social investments and programmes, in close collaboration with our partners in the Thriving Communities Lab. 	
• Engaging with municipal collaborators within the Thriving Communities Lab to ensure a dynamic interplay between research activities and local efforts. 	
• Exploring multi-layered life-course data from the Danish Life Course Cohort (DANLIFE), augmented with local data from the municipal partner, to map the interrelated landscape of well-being among adolescents. 	
• Contributing to scientific publications and engage in the dissemination of research results related to these topics. 	
• Collaborating with researchers in the Center on interdisciplinary projects. 	
• Participating in research-based teaching at the Department of Public Health. 	
• Actively contributing to the development of organisational elements within the Center, such as network activities, website, outreach initiatives, social engagements, scientific meetings, and more.   Profile 

  We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic researcher with the following competences and experience:

   	
• You have a PhD degree in social science, economics, epidemiology, data science, complexity science, computational science, or other related sciences. 	
• You have experience with system dynamics modelling. Experience with agent-based modelling, social return on investment analysis or other analytical frameworks to model social and systemic impacts of social policies and programmes would also be an advantage. 	
• Experience working with Danish register data is an advantage. 	
• You are motivated to engage in participatory processes with practitioners and policymakers, and to collaborate with a variety of stakeholders to foster change. 	
• You have an active interest in complex-systems science applied to public health and epidemiology. 	
• You have proficient communication skills and a proven ability to work in interdisciplinary teams. 	
• You have excellent English skills, both written and spoken. 	
• Danish language skills are an advantage but not essential.   Place of employment

  The place of employment is the Copenhagen Health Complexity Center, Department of Public Health, University of Copenhagen, next to the Lakes in Central Copenhagen.

  Terms of employment 
 The average working hours are 37 hours per week. The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 3 years. The start date is February 1st, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or another relevant organisation. Currently, the monthly salary starts at 35,000 DKK/approx. 4,700 EUR (October 2021 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 17.1 % to your pension fund. Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark for the past 10 years. The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2020.

  Further information

  For specific information about the position, please contact the Associate professor Christopher Jamil de Montgomery: cmon@sund.ku.dk

  Applicants may find the following links useful:

   	
• Copenhagen Health Complexity Center: https://healthcomplex.dk/ 	
• University of Copenhagen: http://ku.dk/english/ 	
• Department of Public Health: http://publichealth.ku.dk/ 	
• International Staff Mobility: https://ism.ku.dk/   Application process

  Your application should be written in English and must include the following documents – all in PDF format:

   	
• Letter of motivation (max 1 page). Please briefly describe your previous research experience and interests as well as what attracts you to the position. 	
• Curriculum Vitae, including a list of publications. 	
• Certified/signed copies of
 	a) PhD certificate (if the PhD has not been completed, a written statement from the applicant’s supervisor will suffice)
 	b) Master of Science certificate. 	
• A research plan (max 2 pages) outlining your ideas for how a decision-support/scenario exploration tool could be developed, drawing on system dynamics modelling or other analytical frameworks suitable for modelling dynamic effects of social policies and programmes.   Please submit your application by clicking on “Apply Now” below. Only online applications will be considered.

  After the expiration of the deadline for applications, the authorised recruitment manager will select applicants for assessment based on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been advanced for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment has been completed, each applicant is given an opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant themselves.

  You can read more about the recruitment process here: https://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

  Application deadline 

  Deadline for applications: 31/10/2026 23.59pm CET 

  We reserve the right to reject material received after the deadline, and to reject applications that do not meet the abovementioned requirements.

  Interviews are expected to be held in week 47-48.

  The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the diversity of society and encourages all qualified candidates to apply regardless of their personal background.

You will build and run its engine keeping the Product and Marketing finance team connected to the financial heartbeat of the company: one planning calendar, one reporting standard, cost control across worldwide envelopes, and an automation toolchain that makes reporting produce itself. You are shaping how this team runs, and the role grows as the toolchain does. As we build the team capabilities, we continue delivering results every quarter, budget every autumn, and the value optimization discipline that funds our growth.

This is a role for someone who is a pace setter, taking real pride in a rhythm that builds credibility, and who wants to modernize how the work gets done.

What you will do

• Own the Product and Marketing financial planning calendar end to end: budget and long-range planning milestones, forecast cycles, month-end and performance review inputs, orchestrating and collaborating so that every corporate deadline is met reliably and consistently.

• Own the reporting catalogue with clear service levels, and build the automation toolchain that produces the recurring suite, retiring manual production as you go.

• Run the functional line into our Global Business Services team: process catalogue, quality, capacity, one blueprint.

• Run cost control for the CMO, CPO and Global Office envelopes as a trusted, independent service.

• Front the team's interface to FP&A and the CFO office, reconciling to one set of definitions.

What is needed to succeed

• 7-10 years in financial planning, reporting or control; you have run a planning calendar or close process end to end.

• Experience building or running a shared-services or offshore interface, with the catalogue and quality rhythm to show for it.

• At least one recurring reporting process you automated, with the manual version retired, and genuine energy for doing it again at scale.

• The independence to hold deadlines, definitions and spend hygiene, including with colleagues more senior than you.

Who you are

• A self-starter: you see the missing process and build it before anyone asks.

• You develop and defend your own point of view: the calendar and the definitions are yours, and you can say no and make it stick, respectfully.

• You believe finance is a strategic copilot to the business, and control done well, an essential guardrail to earn investors' and consumers' trust.

• You can have difficult conversations respectfully, and colleagues trust you more because of them.

• Consumer-centric at heart: you keep the numbers connected to the people who wear the jewellery.

• People-first and collaborator: you make a shared-services team feel like one team, across sites and time zones.

Global Career Band 4B - Manager.

Hybrid Working Flexibility – 3 days in office per week

Location Copenhagen; Global scope.

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

Icing on the cake

You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Senior Software Engineer — Node.js / Serverless Cloud & API Integrations

Do you want to help shape a modern, scalable HR platform used by organisations worldwide?

At HR-ON we’re looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer who enjoys building cloud-native services, optimising data workflows, and—yes—crafting solid API integrations … but treats these as just one part of a varied engineering role.

What You’ll Do

• Design and build core backend services in Node.js & TypeScript running on AWS serverless infrastructure (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, etc.).

• Model and optimise data in PostgreSQL and MariaDB, ensuring performance and reliability at scale.

• Develop and maintain GraphQL & REST endpoints that power our own product features and partner integrations.

• Evolve the platform architecture for resilience, observability, and easy maintenance.

• Automate CI/CD pipelines with GitLab and champion clean-code practices through code reviews and pair-programming.

• Collaborate with product, frontend, and DevOps peers to deliver end-to-end features that delight our users.

API and third-party integrations remain important, but they sit alongside core service development, data engineering, and architectural work.

About You

You’re an experienced engineer who:

• Writes production-grade Node.js/TypeScript and understands modern serverless patterns.

• Knows your way around SQL—from schema design to complex query optimisation.

• Has built GraphQL or REST services and integrated external systems, even if integrations aren’t your sole focus.

• Uses GitLab (or similar) for version control, CI, and automated tests.

• Thinks in terms of scalable, maintainable architecture and values knowledge-sharing with teammates.

Bonus Points

• AWS infrastructure-as-code (CDK, Terraform, CloudFormation).

• Bash/Zsh scripting on *nix systems.

• A fondness for type-safe, declarative coding styles (e.g. fp-inspired TypeScript).

We don’t expect you to tick every box—curiosity and a growth mindset matter most.

Why HR-ON

• High autonomy & influence over tech choices and ways of working.

• Value-based self-management—trust, transparency, and flexibility come first.

• Central Odense office with remote options; we still value regular in-person collaboration.

• 50 passionate colleagues across Denmark, Germany, Norway, and Japan, united by a flat structure and meaningful work.

How to Apply

We assess applications continuously - apply online today, ideally with code samples or project links.

Questions?

We look forward to hearing from you!

Do you want to use your skills in pioneering technology in a highly dynamic, ambitious environment with broad variety of exciting projects? In Welltec, cutting-edge technology and global development are high on the agenda, and we are looking for colleagues within mechanical engineering to take this journey to the next level.

A world-class company

Welltec® is an international oilfield service company and a leading specialist partner to the energy industry.

Our values are to be Pioneering, Visionary, Dedicated, and Agile.

We develop and manufacture precision-controlled technologies which provide the most unique and advanced Completion and Intervention solutions, which assist our clients in maximizing recovery from their assets.

We always look to the future, utilizing our intelligence, imagination and expertise to create new opportunities. We have won several industry awards for innovative thinking. We are enjoying constant growth worldwide through the wide adoption of our cutting-edge solutions.

Our policy is to hire locally and work globally. We therefore recruit where we are active and train our employees to operate our state-of-the-art technologies to provide services to our high-profile clients in the region.

The global dimension offers a range of opportunities for those who are motivated by a challenging and multicultural environment where employees come with very different backgrounds but with a common wish to collaborate and succeed.

The department

Welltec as a company is a truly global diverse team with over 60 nationalities in total. At Welltec, you will join our mechanical department situated in our Design & Engineering (D&E) function which currently consists of 33 colleagues with various educational backgrounds and nationalities. The D&E function also includes electronic and software engineers. In D&E we also work in smaller project groups – Mechanical-, Electrical- and Software Engineers together - in order to get a holistic approach to our products and tools and to benefit from each other’s knowledge and expertise. In D&E, the work environment is informal, creative and fun but at times it can be complex, challenging, and fast-paced.

The team that you will join is responsible for the development and maintenance of Welltec’s proprietary well intervention technologies, ranging from our Well Tractor with more than 20 years of service time to new and innovative technologies which we constantly introduce to the market through our global footprint.

The position

Your tasks will include:

• Develop new tools to solve cutting-edge problems.

• Work on technical projects through all development phases.

• Work in teams on development projects with both individual and shared responsibilities.

• Conceptualization and feasibility studies.

• Design reviews guided by DFM, FMEA principles and robust design thinking.

• 3D mechanical design.

• Plan, prepare and perform practical functional and verification testing of prototypes, tools and systems.

• Apply a structured and systematic approach to troubleshooting and root cause analysis during practical testing and development.

• Troubleshoot both existing solutions and new solutions under development, combining engineering analysis with hands-on testing.

• Provide guidance and input within your specific areas of expertise across the organization.

• Participate in project-related travel when required, including support for testing, troubleshooting, qualification activities and other project needs at Welltec locations, suppliers or customer sites.

The candidate

You are proactive in your daily tasks and have an analytical and critical approach to problem solving. You have a quick, creative mind with a natural understanding of complex concepts and systems.

The ideal candidate is someone who gets excited by technology, practical engineering and open-ended challenges. You are comfortable moving between engineering analysis, CAD design and hands-on testing, and you approach technical problems in a structured and systematic way.

In order to perform well in this role, you should have the following qualifications or similar competencies:

The preferred candidate has the following profile:

• Mechanical Engineer B.Sc., M.Sc. or similar background.

• Experience from the energy sector, hydraulics, precision mechanics, electromechanical systems, mechatronics, oilfield or similar.

• Possesses relevant deep technical knowledge and is able to apply it broadly with impact.

• Takes ownership of tasks and projects and enjoys broad responsibility.

• Strong hands-on engineering mindset with experience in practical functional testing, verification and systematic troubleshooting.

• Able to translate test observations and failures into root causes, design improvements and clear next actions.

• Agile Project Management skills.

• Knows when to supervise and delegate tasks to maximize efficiency and avoid bottlenecks.

• Experienced CAD user in CATIA or a similar system.

• Willing and able to travel as required to support project activities, testing and technical problem solving.

What we offer

Working with Welltec® means challenges and personal development in a demanding work environment. It is exciting and rewarding, and it is a varied place to work. Welltec® is an equal opportunity employer. We offer good career opportunities for the right candidate. Also, Welltec® has a competitive compensation package.

The process

We are looking for Systems Engineers for 1 permanent position and 1 12-months maternity cover position to strengthen our combined Systems & Test Engineering team in Product Development at Coloplast. The role supports ongoing development by driving systems engineering and design control execution in close collaboration with R&D specialists, Test Engineering, QA, Scientific Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, and Project Management.

Your responsibilities:

•    Drive and support design control and product risk management activities in development projects.

•    Translate stakeholders into clear, high-quality system and subsystem requirements with end-to-end traceability.

•    Own and contribute to systems engineering documentation, including design input/output, product description, and risk documentation.

•    Support design verification and validation planning and execution in close collaboration with Test Engineering.

•    Participate in design reviews, change control, and impact assessments.

•    Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory and quality requirements (e.g. MDR, FDA, ISO 13485, ISO 14971).

•    Collaborate closely with cross-functional project teams to support timely project execution.

Your background

•    Experience with systems engineering and design control in a regulated environment required for permanent position (medical devices are an advantage).

•    Knowledge of risk management, requirements engineering, and traceability.

•    Experience working cross-functionally with R&D, Test, Quality, and Regulatory stakeholders.

•    Strong analytical and communication skills.

•    Experience with Polarion or similar ALM tools is an advantage.

What we offer

A 12-months temporary position and a permanent position in a collaborative and learning environment with strong focus on quality, high professional standards, good sparring and learning. You will get real responsibility from the start and the opportunity to build strong capability in systems engineering and regulated product development. You will collaborate closely with experienced colleagues in Systems Engineering, Test Engineering, and Product Development.
